jobs.title: Backend Software Engineer - Data Connectors
jobs.description:
A World-Changing Company
 
Palantir builds the world’s leading software for data-driven decisions and operations. By bringing the right data to the people who need it, our platforms empower our partners to develop lifesaving drugs, forecast supply chain disruptions, locate missing children, and more.
 
The Role
 
The Connectivity team builds the software that connects Palantir’s platform to customer systems. Our connectors integrate databases, enterprise applications, cloud storage, web services, and streaming systems, enabling customers to bring data into Foundry and write back to their operational systems. From large datasets to real-time events and user-driven interactions, these connections underpin the applications and AI workflows customers build with Foundry and AIP.
 
You’ll build and maintain Foundry’s first-class connector suite and the shared infrastructure behind it. You’ll work across the stack, taking ownership of connector implementations, developer SDKs, and the systems that build, test, distribute, and run our connectivity software.
 
A central part of this work is evolving and scaling a large, established codebase. You’ll move integrations from bespoke infrastructure onto shared platform capabilities, design SDKs that enable other teams and customers to build integrations independently, and safely retire older implementations. You’ll also build observability and diagnostic tools that help users understand, monitor, and troubleshoot their connections. You’ll own improvements from design through production and use what you learn from operating connectors to strengthen the platform they share.

Technologies We Use
- Java and Python for connectors, backend services, and developer SDKs

- Open-source technologies like Kafka, Kubernetes, Flink, Debezium, Iceberg

- Industry-standard build tooling, including Gradle and GitHub

- Shared job orchestration, streaming, serverless execution, and compute deployment platforms

Core Responsibilities
- Build and maintain Foundry’s first-class connectors, improving performance and extending support for imports, exports, change data capture, interactive queries, and writeback as external systems and customer needs evolve.

- Improve the infrastructure that builds, tests, packages, and distributes connectors and shared libraries, including tooling across our connector monorepo.

- Design and maintain connectivity SDKs for internal teams and end users, with clear APIs, documentation, testing utilities, and development workflows that make integrations easy to author and maintain.

- Collaborate with product teams to integrate connector execution with job orchestration, streaming, and serverless platforms.

- Lead incremental migrations onto shared infrastructure, manage compatibility, and retire older implementations while preserving the workflows customers depend on.

- Develop reusable security frameworks and tooling that make secure connectivity a consistent part of connector development and execution.

- Debug production issues and performance problems across the stack, turning recurring support problems into durable fixes, automated tests, and better observability.

- Establish shared testing frameworks, compatibility checks, and release practices that keep a large connector portfolio reliable and maintainable.

- Help prepare and maintain Palantir connectivity software for open-source use, including its APIs, packaging, documentation, and contributor experience.

What We Value
- An ownership mindset and a high bar for correctness, security, and automated testing, including responsibility for how software behaves in production.

- Pride in building and maintaining integrations over time, including the detailed work required to keep them reliable as upstream systems change.

- Engineering judgment that balances delivering new capabilities with simplifying existing systems and reducing operational burden.

- Empathy for developers and end users, reflected in usable SDKs, clear configuration, actionable errors, and useful diagnostics.

- Curiosity about unfamiliar systems and persistence in debugging problems across languages, APIs, services, networks, and execution environments.

What We Require
- 4+ years of professional software engineering experience developing external system connectors, with depth in areas such as developing batch and streaming data ingestion systems, third-party integration development, or monorepo and asset distribution frameworks. Operating on top of these technologies alone does not qualify.

- Deep expertise in Gradle, including developing custom plugins, managing multi-project builds, and optimizing build performance.

- Demonstrated ability to diagnose complex reliability and performance problems and improve systems through measured, incremental changes.

- Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work effectively across teams, incorporate feedback, and hold a high bar for quality.

Salary
 
The estimated salary range for this position is estimated to be $135,000 - $200,000/year. Total compensation for this position may also include Restricted Stock units, sign-on bonus and other potential future incentives. Further note that total compensation for this position will be determined by each individual’s relevant qualifications, work experience, skills, and other factors. This estimate excludes the value of any potential sign-on bonus; the value of any benefits offered; and the potential future value of any long-term incentives.
 
Life at Palantir
We want every Palantirian to achieve their best outcomes, that’s why we celebrate individuals’ strengths, skills, and interests, from your first interview to your longterm growth, rather than rely on traditional career ladders. Paying attention to the needs of our community enables us to optimize our opportunities to grow and helps ensure many pathways to success at Palantir. Promoting health and well-being across all areas of Palantirians’ lives is just one of the ways we’re investing in our community. Learn more at Life at Palantir and note that our offerings may vary by region.
 
In keeping consistent with Palantir’s values and culture, we believe employees are “better together” and in-person work affords the opportunity for more creative outcomes. Therefore, we encourage employees to work from our offices to foster connectivity and innovation. Many teams do offer hybrid options (WFH a day or two a week), allowing our employees to strike the right trade-off for their personal productivity. Based on business need, there are a few roles that allow for “Remote” work on an exceptional basis. If you are applying for one of these roles, you must work from the city and or country in which you are employed. If the posting is specified as Onsite, you are required to work from an office.
 
If you want to empower the world's most important institutions, you belong here. Palantir values excellence regardless of background. We are committed to making the application and hiring process accessible to everyone and will provide a reasonable accommodation for those living with a disability. If you need an accommodation for the application or hiring process, please reach out and let us know how we can help.
 
Please note that you will never be asked to submit a payment or share financial information to participate in our interview process. If you suspect that you've been contacted by a scammer, we recommend you cease all communication with the individual and consider reporting them to the relevant authorities, such as the US FBI Internet Crime Complaint Center (IC3).

jobs.title: Security Engineer, Privy
jobs.description:
Who we are

About Privy

Our mission is to make privacy and user ownership the default online. To do so, we build simple, flexible APIs and tools for developers that make it easy to build new products on crypto rails.

Privy owns the abstractions and infrastructure layer above wallets, integrating across chains, third-party providers, and Stripe products like Treasury and Link. We get to solve hard technical problems while leveraging Stripe's distribution to reach customers like Ramp, Klarna, Deel, Kraken, Hyperliquid, and Fomo — powering experiences for both mainstream users and crypto natives.

Learn more about Privy: Privy and Stripe: Bringing crypto to everyone

About the team

Engineering at Privy is distinguished by:

- High urgency: Shipping very small iterations, very fast, to learn very quickly.

- Product taste: Our customers are developers, and to build effective products for them requires technical knowledge - you will often be "the PM".

- Security mindset: A great portion of our product is trust. While we have a dedicated security team, every engineer brings security to their designs from the start.

In practice, we use boring technology like Node, React, and AWS so we can focus our engineering energy entirely on pushing the boundaries of Privy's core product, e.g. through hardware enclaves, multi-region low latency APIs, and blockchain abstractions that are accessible to mainstream developers.

What you’ll do

As a Security Engineer at Privy, you will help keep a rapidly growing platform secure through hands-on investigation, operational ownership, and building real code to solve real problems. You’ll work across security operations, incident response, application and infrastructure security, and internal tooling.

This is not a role limited to reviewing logs and designs or simply escalating findings. You will carry real ownership for the day-to-day work that protects Privy: investigating anomalies, improving security workflows, and building the automation that makes the team faster and more effective over time. You’ll work closely with engineers across Privy and alongside specialists in cryptography, application security, offensive security, and infrastructure security to turn security expertise into practical, durable outcomes.

Responsibilities

- Own security engineering work end to end: investigate alerts, findings, anomalies, and security requests; identify root causes; drive remediation; and clearly document outcomes.

- Participate in Privy’s security on-call rotation, helping respond to incidents, triage alerts, support vulnerability workflows, complete access reviews, and handle security escalations.

- Build and maintain production-quality tooling that reduces manual work, including alert enrichment, automated triage and routing, remediation workflows, access-review automation, and detection improvements.

- Lead focused investigations into suspected security events or compromises, gathering evidence methodically and coordinating the appropriate response.

- Proactively identify recurring sources of operational toil and engineer durable solutions that improve the team’s speed, consistency, and ability to scale.

- Partner with product and engineering teams to assess security risks, review lower-complexity designs and implementation plans, and make practical security tradeoffs to deliver quickly with quality and soundness.

- Contribute across Privy’s application, infrastructure, cloud, and product-security surface area, developing broad context while building deeper expertise over time.

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

- Experience as a security engineer, detection engineer, or similarly hands-on engineer in a technically demanding environment.

- Strong software-engineering skills in Python, Go, Ruby, or a similar language. You can build maintainable tooling and contribute directly to production fixes, not only one-off scripts.

- Experience investigating security signals, incidents, vulnerabilities, suspicious activity, or other ambiguous technical problems through to resolution.

- Familiarity with security operations, incident response, vulnerability management, detection engineering, access reviews, or related operational-security workflows.

- A strong understanding of web, browser, infrastructure, or cloud security, with the ability to apply that understanding across a broad range of problems.

- Good judgment under pressure, a methodical approach to investigation, and comfort working independently with agency despite incomplete information.

- Strong communication and collaboration skills, including the ability to explain technical findings, risks, and recommended actions clearly to clients and internal stakeholders alike.

- A self-directed approach to work: you notice gaps, make progress through ambiguity, and reliably close the loop.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with AWS, GCP, or other cloud-security environments.

- Experience with detection engineering, security automation, incident-response tooling, or remediation pipelines.

- Bug-bounty experience, offensive-security exposure, or a strong attacker-minded approach to investigation.

- Experience with IAM, secrets management, secure production access, or secure CI/CD.

- Background in application security, infrastructure security, cryptography, or privacy engineering.

- Experience with fintech, payments, blockchain, or another diligence-forward financial product domain.

- Experience helping shape security operations, incident-response practices, vulnerability-management workflows, or a bug-bounty program.

jobs.title: Site Reliability Engineer II
jobs.description:
Join Axon and be a Force for Good.

At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.

Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.

Your Impact

As a Site Reliability Engineer on the Kubernetes team in Axon's Compute Platform Engineering (CPE) organization, you'll help run and evolve the platform that Axon's products run on: a large, global fleet of Azure AKS and Amazon EKS clusters across commercial and government clouds. You care about system stability, clear documentation, and tools that make the platform easy and safe for engineering teams to use. You'll own platform features end to end, from design through rollout.

Location: This role is based out of our Boston, MA, Atlanta, GA, or Seattle, WA office and follows a hybrid schedule. We rely on in-person collaboration and ask that team members work onsite Tuesdays through Fridays, with the flexibility to work remotely on Mondays, unless there is an approved workplace accommodation.

Reports to: Engineering Manager, Compute Platform Engineering

What You'll Do

- Own platform features and components end to end, including design docs and rollout plans.

- Review teammates' changes and share operational knowledge across the team and with partner teams.

- Build and operate robust, easy-to-use Kubernetes platforms and tooling that let engineering teams provision and run services rapidly, consistently, and securely.

- Automate cluster provisioning, bootstrapping, upgrades, and day-2 operations with infrastructure as code and GitOps.

- Continually improve reliability, operability, and cost efficiency across the fleet, including node autoscaling and right-sizing.

- Keep the platform secure and compliant through policy enforcement, vulnerability remediation, and government-cloud requirements such as FIPS.

- Debug problems in cloud-native distributed systems, and take part in the team's on-call rotation.

- Write code that is performant, maintainable, clear, and concise.

- Write documentation and guides that let engineers self-serve.

- Use agentic AI tooling to automate platform operations and accelerate the team's engineering work.

- Take calculated risks, champion new ideas, and cultivate your craft.

What You Bring

- 3+ years of experience in platform engineering, SRE, or infrastructure engineering

- Experience building and operating Kubernetes platforms such as AKS, EKS, or similar in production

- Experience building platforms on Azure or AWS

- Experience with a programming language such as Python, Go, C#, Java, or similar

- Experience with CI/CD and Git-based workflows to automate infrastructure provisioning, builds, tests, and releases

- Experience with infrastructure as code (Terraform, Pulumi, or similar), including flexible, testable modules

- Experience using observability tools (metrics, logs, traces, APM) to debug issues

- Experience designing tooling that simplifies the operation of SaaS/PaaS systems

- Hands-on experience applying AI and agentic tooling to engineering or operations work

- Empathy for the needs of software engineers

- United States citizenship, required to obtain CJIS clearance for full access to US production environments

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with GitOps using ArgoCD and Helm

- Experience with cluster autoscaling and cost optimization (Karpenter, Vertical Pod Autoscaler, or similar)

- Experience with Kubernetes policy and security tooling (Kyverno, OPA/Gatekeeper, or similar)

- Experience in government or regulated cloud environments (Azure Government, FedRAMP/GovRAMP, CJIS)

- Exposure to 24/7 high-volume systems with formal SLA requirements

Benefits that Benefit You

- Competitive salary and 401k with employer match

- Discretionary paid time off

- Paid parental leave for all

- Medical, Dental, Vision plans

- Fitness Programs

- Emotional & Mental Wellness support

- Learning & Development programs

- Employee Resource Groups (ERGs)

- And yes, we have snacks in our offices

Benefits listed herein may vary depending on the nature of your employment and the location where you work.

Axon is a total compensation company, meaning compensation is made up of base pay, bonus, and stock awards. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: level, function, training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs, geographic market, and often a combination of all these factors. Our benefits offer an array of options to help support you physically, financially and emotionally through the big milestones and in your everyday life. To see more details on our benefits offerings please visit https://www.axon.com/careers.

Base Pay Range

$115,500—$184,800 USD

Don’t meet every single requirement? That's ok. At Axon, we Aim Far. We think big with a long-term view because we want to reinvent the world to be a safer, better place. We are also committed to building diverse teams that reflect the communities we serve.

Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they check every box in the job description. If you’re excited about this role and our mission to Protect Life but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification listed here, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

Important Notes

The above job description is not intended as, nor should it be construed as, exhaustive of all duties, responsibilities, skills, efforts, or working conditions associated with this job. The job description may change or be supplemented at any time in accordance with business needs and conditions.

Some roles may also require legal eligibility to work in a firearms environment.

- Learn from senior engineers, participate in code reviews, and apply best practices to improve code quality and your own frontend skills

- Foundational frontend performance skills: ability to use profiling tools, identify performance bottlenecks, and implement basic optimizations

- Familiarity with binary streaming protocols (WebSockets/protobuf) and offloading work to Web Workers

jobs.title: Cloud - Bare Metal Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description:
At Render, we’re building the modern cloud platform for developers creating AI-native, full-stack, multi-service applications. Our mission is to eliminate the tradeoff between the power of hyperscalers and the simplicity of developer-friendly platforms—so teams can ship fast, scale reliably, and focus on their product, not infrastructure.

Unlike complex hyperscalers or ephemeral edge/serverless solutions, Render offers a developer-first experience with persistent compute, dynamic autoscaling, built-in orchestration, and observability, allowing teams to launch, scale, and manage real-world applications without writing infrastructure code or managing servers. Whether you're building LLM-powered applications, scalable SaaS products, or async processing pipelines, Render empowers teams to move fast and scale confidently from MVP to millions of users.

Our platform is trusted by over 7 million developers worldwide and continues to grow rapidly. In February 2026, we raised an additional $100M in Series C financing, bringing our total funding to $260M, to accelerate our vision of making cloud infrastructure both powerful and intuitive—designed for the speed of modern AI development.

We’re a diverse and talented team that values craft, velocity, and user experience. If you’re excited to help shape the future of the intelligent cloud and empower developers everywhere, we’d love to hear from you.




APPLYING TO RENDER

We're seeking candidates who possess high integrity, humility, and an insatiable drive to learn. Through reasoned discussions and continuous feedback, we strive to improve both individually and collectively. We foster an environment of mutual trust and respect, empowering effective debate to achieve the best outcomes for our customers and team.

We especially encourage members of underrepresented groups in the tech community to apply and understand that not all successful candidates will meet each requirement listed.

Our interview process is unique to each role, and we value the candidate experience just as much as our customer experience. We hope your conversations with us reflect a thoughtful process that is illuminative, enjoyable, and respectful of your time.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Most infrastructure engineers never get to build a cloud from the metal up. At Render, you will. Developers and businesses around the world run their apps on Render, and we are building our own bare metal footprint to give them better performance and economics. You'll help take our first colocation site from an empty cage to production workloads, then scale that foundation as we expand our physical presence to thousands of hosts over the coming years.

You'll join a small, experienced team with real ownership. You'll partner closely with network engineering and our Kubernetes platform team, and the decisions you make now will become the template for every site that follows.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Take our first colocation site from empty cage to production workloads, then scale what you build as we grow to more sites and thousands of hosts

 - Design how servers go from the loading dock to production with minimal human touch: netboot, imaging, BMC-driven discovery, and host identity

 - Partner with network engineering on what the fleet needs from the network, from out-of-band management to production connectivity

 - Build the interface our Kubernetes platform team uses to request capacity, see host health, and coordinate maintenance, so consuming bare metal feels as easy as consuming cloud

 - Own the fleet's source of truth for hardware, software, and the physical environment

 - Automate the full server lifecycle, from burn-in and acceptance testing through remediation, staged firmware rollout, and RMA

 - Build automation like a production system, with guardrails on destructive actions and designs that survive site-level failure

 - Shape the technical and operational direction of our bare metal platform, from build-vs-buy decisions to how we operate thousands of hosts, and help hire the team that runs it


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Hands-on experience building and operating automation for bare metal fleets in datacenters or colocation

 - Both sides of the work: time with physical hardware and colo providers, and modern, software-driven fleet management

 - Strong Go or Python, and experience designing systems with reconciliation loops and idempotent, failure-tolerant actions

 - Depth below the abstraction: you know what your tools are doing under the hood and can debug them when they fail

 - Experience operating through real failures, such as bad hardware batches, flapping BMCs, or a rollout you had to halt

 - Deep Linux knowledge and solid networking fundamentals (DHCP, PXE, DNS, BGP)

 - Working knowledge of Kubernetes, enough to design the interface between the fleet and the clusters that run on it

 - Clear communication, comfort with ambiguity, and the willingness to push back on a plan when something doesn't add up


NICE-TO-HAVES

 - Operating bare metal fleets at a scale of thousands of hosts

 - Experience on a bare metal or datacenter build-out from its early days

 - Running a hybrid environment, or moving workloads between public cloud and owned hardware

 - DCIM/IPAM tools such as NetBox or Nautobot, or provisioning stacks such as Ironic/Metal3, Tinkerbell, or MAAS

 - Building reconcilers or state machines for physical infrastructure

 - Hardware depth: component diagnostics, burn-in tooling, firmware, or Redfish and IPMI at fleet scale

 - Building internal platforms or APIs used by other infrastructure teams

 - Based near our colocation sites, or able to visit them regularly

If this role excites you but you don’t meet every single requirement, we’d still love to hear from you—your unique experience might be just what we need.




BENEFITS

 - 4 weeks of paid vacation.

 - 14 weeks of fully paid parental leave for all parents to bond with a newly born, adopted, or fostered child. We will also work with you to create a supportive plan of return.

 - Long-term disability, life insurance, and 401K plans.

 - 100% employer-paid medical coverage and 99% employer-paid dental and vision coverage for you and a dependent. FSAs and HSAs are available as well.

 - Monthly lifestyle stipend for wellness, mental health and therapy, hobbies, etc.

 - Monthly cell phone and internet subsidy.

 - Commuter benefits for Renders in the Bay Area, and home office stipends for remote Renders.

 - Continuous learning benefits & related support.

This position is generally not eligible for new visa sponsorship. At Render's discretion, the business may sponsor existing visa transfers. Applicants who require sponsorship must receive business authorization.

Render is an equal-opportunity employer. We know that employing a team rich in diverse thoughts, experiences, and opinions allows our employees, product, and community to flourish. We make all employment decisions including hiring, evaluation, termination, promotional, and training opportunities, without regard to race, religion, color, sex, age, national origin, ancestry, sexual orientation, physical handicap, mental disability, medical condition, disability, gender or identity or expression, pregnancy or pregnancy-related condition, marital status, height and/or weight.

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

We encourage all who are interested to apply. We can't wait to hear from you!

jobs.title: AI deployment engineer (East)
jobs.description:
🚀 ABOUT WRITER

WRITER is the AI platform built for the world’s most ambitious marketing and revenue teams, bringing the frontier of AI to the people who drive enterprise growth. With WRITER, autonomous agents work across the buyer journey, continuously executing on market signals and enterprise intelligence to grow revenue faster. Every agent action and asset is grounded in trust, built on an Enterprise Brain that unites brand, product, and company knowledge with fiduciary-grade governance and compliance. 



Fortune 500 companies are transforming how they go to market with WRITER, including 3 of the top 5 US banks, 2 of the 5 largest global CPG conglomerates, and 4 of the top 5 US healthcare insurers. Founded in 2020, WRITER is backed by investors including Insight Partners, ICONIQ, Radical Ventures, Premji Invest, Balderton, B Capital, Salesforce Ventures, Adobe Ventures, Accenture, Citi Ventures, IBM Ventures, WndrCo, and others. Learn more at WRITER.com http://WRITER.com.

 


📐 ABOUT THE ROLE

As a deployment engineer at WRITER, you'll be at the forefront of expanding human capacity through superintelligence. This isn't just a technical role; it's a deeply influential one where you'll partner directly with our leading enterprise customers. Your expertise will be crucial in uncovering their unique business challenges and architecting AI-powered solutions that leverage our powerful platform and enterprise-grade LLMs. You'll transform complex needs into tangible, high-impact applications, creating champions and driving tangible business results. Your builder's mentality and passion for bringing cutting-edge AI into the hands of real users will directly shape the future of work for some of the world's largest companies.

This is a critical role that directly impacts our customers' success and product evolution. You'll contribute significantly to WRITER's mission, working with a dynamic team to push the boundaries of what's possible with generative AI.

This is a hybrid role based out of our San Francisco, Chicago, Austin, New York City, Seattle, and London hubs.

We are open to hiring for this role at multiple levels, with compensation ranges scaled to match your experience, expertise, and the scope of the role.

 


🦸🏻‍♀️ WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Partner deeply with enterprise customers to identify strategic AI use cases, validating technical feasibility and owning the end-to-end implementation of tailored solutions

 - Architect and deliver custom applications, templates, and integrations leveraging WRITER's platform, APIs, and Knowledge Graph capabilities to solve complex business challenges

 - Translate intricate technical concepts and platform capabilities into clear, prescriptive solution recommendations, guiding customers through the generative AI landscape

 - Collaborate relentlessly with internal Product and Engineering teams, providing crucial customer feedback that directly influences our product roadmap and drives continuous innovation

 - Drive down customer time-to-value by developing scalable processes, robust documentation, and efficient workflows for technical integrations

 - Champion the successful adoption and expansion of WRITER's AI solutions within customer accounts, ensuring maximum impact and return on investment

 


⭐️ WHAT YOU NEED

 - Over 5 years of hands-on experience in technical SaaS roles, with at least 3 years specifically in solutions architecture, technical consulting, or technical account management

 - Deep technical fluency in Python and extensive experience leveraging APIs, especially in designing sophisticated prompts and understanding linguistic principles for AI applications

 - Proven track record of architecting and delivering complex technical solutions for Fortune 500 enterprises in a fast-paced, high-growth B2B SaaS environment

 - Exceptional communication and executive presence, capable of simplifying complex AI concepts for diverse audiences, from technical teams to C-suite leadership

 - A true builder's mindset with a passion for emerging technologies, always eager to experiment, learn, and iterate in the rapidly evolving world of generative AI

 - A relentless drive to Connect with customers and internal teams, Challenge the status status quo with innovative solutions, and Own the successful outcomes for our most strategic accounts


🍩 Benefits & perks (US Full-time employees)

 - Generous PTO, plus company holidays

 - Medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your family

 - Paid parental leave for all parents (16 weeks)

 - Fertility and family planning support

 - Early-detection cancer testing through Galleri https://www.galleri.com/partner/writer

 - Flexible spending account and dependent FSA options

 - Health savings account for eligible plans with company contribution

 - Annual work-life stipends for:
   
   - Wellness stipend for gym, massage/chiropractor, personal training, etc.
   
   - Learning and development stipend

 - Company-wide off-sites and team off-sites

 - Competitive compensation, company stock options and 401k

WRITER is an equal-opportunity employer and is committed to diversity. We don't make hiring or employment decisions based on race, color, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, sex, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, citizenship, or any other basis protected by applicable local, state or federal law. jobs.description:

WRITER is the AI platform built for the world’s most ambitious marketing and revenue teams, bringing the frontier of AI to the people who drive enterprise growth. Fortune 500 companies are transforming how they go to market with WRITER, including 3 of the top 5 US banks, 2 of the 5 largest global CPG conglomerates, and 4 of the top 5 US healthcare insurers. Founded in 2020, WRITER is backed by investors including Insight Partners, ICONIQ, Radical Ventures, Premji Invest, Balderton, B Capital, Salesforce Ventures, Adobe Ventures, Accenture, Citi Ventures, IBM Ventures, WndrCo, and others. Learn more at WRITER.com http://WRITER.com.

 

📐 About the role

At WRITER, our mission to expand human capacity with superintelligence relies on a foundational truth: our platform must be available, performant, and reliable, 24/7. As an Infrastructure engineer, you'll be at the heart of making this a reality, impacting every enterprise customer who trusts us with their AI-powered workflows. This isn't just about keeping the lights on; it's about pushing the boundaries of what's possible, proactively identifying and solving complex systemic challenges, and laying the groundwork for our rapid growth and the evolving demands of enterprise generative AI. You'll build resilient systems, automate across the stack, and champion reliability best practices, directly enabling our ambitious product roadmap and ensuring our customers always have access to the powerful tools they need.

This is a hybrid position, based out of our New York City, San Francisco, Seattle, or London hubs. You'll report to our director of engineering.

We are open to hiring for this role at multiple levels, with compensation ranges scaled to match your experience, expertise, and the scope of the role.

 

🦸🏻‍♀️ What you'll do

Technical

 - Breadth across disciplines. Bring deep focus to one problem at a time, with the breadth to move between SRE, DevOps, Infrastructure, and Platform work over a quarter or two as the leverage shifts. This is not a thrash-every-week role — most of the time you're heads-down on one substantial initiative (the on-call posture, the release pipeline, the multi-region Terraform layout, the internal platform surface). Cross-layer fluency is what lets you pick the right next initiative; it isn't a weekly context-switch.

 - Simplicity / via negativa. Challenge the status quo and remove toil before adding features — automate operational tasks and infrastructure management with Python or Go, reject tools that don't fit the problem, and treat manual on-call work as a defect to be designed out, not a status quo to be staffed up.

 - Breadth across the stack. Design scalable, fault-tolerant infrastructure across AWS (preferred), GCP, and Azure, working fluently across Kubernetes, Helm, Terraform, and the supporting cloud and AI tooling that backs WRITER's high-traffic platform.

 - AI in workflow. Run agents in your daily loop — Claude Code, Droid, Codex, internal skills — to investigate incidents, draft Terraform / Helm changes, write runbooks, scaffold tooling, and review PRs. Build the agentic setup as a collective surface: humans and digital teammates working as one team, with shared skills, shared context, and shared on-call workflows. Encode recurring infra tasks as internal skills any teammate (human or agent) can pick up and run, so the team's throughput compounds — not just your own.

 - Debugging fluency. Lead incident response, post-mortems, and root-cause analyses — trace failures to the underlying problem (never the symptom), apply the learning back into the architecture, and prevent the same incident from happening twice.

Non-technical

 - End-to-end ownership. Own the reliability, performance, and efficiency of WRITER's core services end-to-end — define and uphold the SLOs and error budgets, carry the on-call pager, and stand behind the outcome metric, not just the system you shipped.

 - Strategic vs. tactical balance. Balance this week's critical work with the 6–12-month platform direction — ship the on-call-driving fix today while shaping the multi-year observability, cost, and reliability investments that move WRITER's enterprise customers.

 - Cross-functional collaboration. Operate at the seams with product, security, and engineering peers — provide expert guidance on system design for reliability, performance, and scalability from conception through launch, Connect the infra agenda to product and revenue context, and disagree with evidence, not volume.

 

⭐️ What you need

Technical

 - Track record. 5+ years of experience in infrastructure engineering, DevOps, or a similar role focused on building and operating large-scale, high-availability production systems at a high-growth product company.

 - Breadth. Experience running containerisation in production (a real cluster, not a lab), with experience in Helm and Terraform or Pulumi on at least one major cloud (AWS preferred), plus good proficiency in Python or Go for automation and tooling.

 - AI in workflow. AI is part of how you ship, not a thing you've read about — agentic tooling (Claude Code, Droid, Codex, internal skills) is in your daily loop, you've built or adopted AI-assisted workflows others now use, and you have strong opinions on where it's unreliable. This is a hard requirement, not a bonus. Candidates whose actual daily workflow does not already include AI tooling will not be advanced.

 - First-principles + decision-making. Demonstrated ability to Challenge the status quo, proactively identify systemic weaknesses, and propose innovative solutions to complex reliability problems — reason from constraints and failure modes (not analogy or vendor defaults), name the tradeoff in business terms (reliability vs. velocity, cost vs. blast radius, standardisation vs. one-off), and reject the "best practices" answer when it doesn't fit the problem.

 - Reversibility & blast-radius. Make reversible calls by default — write the rollback before you touch production, work fluently with monitoring and logging stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK or equivalent), and stress the system in safe places so it comes back stronger.

Non-technical

 - Cross-functional collaboration. Excellent communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills, with a talent for building strong relationships and Connecting with cross-functional teams — surface non-goals before anyone asks, and partner with product, security, and platform peers as one delivery surface.

 - Autonomy & end-to-end ownership. A strong sense of ownership and accountability, eager to Own mission-critical systems and drive them toward peak performance and unparalleled reliability. At least one 0-to-1 infrastructure build you owned end-to-end, with the outcome metric attached.

 

🎁 Bonus if you have

 - Software-engineering depth. A software-engineering background, not only config and scripting — you've designed, built, and shipped non-trivial production code (services, libraries, internal frameworks) in Python, Go, or a comparable language, you can read and modify the codebases your infrastructure runs, and you move between infra automation and feature engineering without changing brains.

jobs.title: Security Engineer (Detection & Response)
jobs.description:
1 in 4 people in the US have a treatable mental health condition, but most providers don't accept insurance, making therapy too expensive for most people. Headway’s mission is to fix this by building a new mental healthcare system everyone can access. We started by solving the biggest barrier to care: insurance. The admin work - credentialing, claims, payment reconciliation - is a nightmare. We've automated that.



But we're going further. Over 90,000 providers across all 50 states run their practice on our software, serving over 2.6 million patients. We are building the best tools for therapists to run their entire practice, reimagining the experience of finding a therapist, and investing in the platform foundations to enable this at scale, and building much of it with AI. We aren't just a billing layer; we are becoming the platform where care actually happens.



We're a Series D company with $325M+ in funding (a16z, Accel, Spark Capital, etc.), looking for exceptional people to help us achieve this mission. We want your time here to be the most meaningful experience of your career. Join us, and help change mental healthcare for the better.




ABOUT THE ROLE

The Security team at Headway is responsible for the security and privacy of all of Headway's customers — therapists, patients, and payer partners (insurance companies and health systems). As a Security Engineer on our Detection & Response team, you'll help build the capabilities we use to identify, respond to, and contain potential threats across our production and corporate environments — ensuring our logging is adequate and accessible, our detections cover real-time monitoring and alerting, and our incident response is well-documented and well-rehearsed.

This role scales alongside the volume of data our business generates and consumes, and alongside our ambition to work smarter — not just harder — by applying automation and AI where it genuinely helps, and knowing when it doesn't.

 

What you'll do at Headway:

 - Detection engineering: Build and refine detections, logging/telemetry coverage, and tooling (SIEM/ETL pipeline refinement) so we have real-time visibility into anomalous and malicious activity across cloud, corporate, and SaaS environments.

 - Incident response engineering: Run incident response activities, threat hunting, and threat modeling — and continuously improve our processes and documentation so the team gets faster and sharper after every incident.

 - AI security tooling and automation: Implement automation and AI where it's the right tool for the job — and push back when it isn't. You'll help define what "AI-forward" detection and response looks like at Headway without over-rotating on it.

 - Security alert triage: Triage security alerts and build deep familiarity with our environment so you can separate signal from noise quickly.

 - Team contributions: Participate in the security on-call rotation, author runbooks, contribute to security education and partnership across engineering, and mentor peers.

 - Documentation: Keep detections, logging capabilities, runbooks, response processes, and threat intel well-documented so knowledge compounds across the team.

Tools we use:

 - Languages: Python 3, TypeScript

 - Infrastructure: AWS (Fargate, ECS, S3, and more)

 - Datastores: PostgreSQL, Snowflake

 - Monitoring & Response: Datadog, PagerDuty

 - Version Control: GitHub

 - Security Tooling: Anthropic, Wiz, Semgrep, Datadog, Tines

You’ll be great for this role if you have:

 - Dedicated experience of 1-2+ years with responsibilities related to security response and automation OR a security-adjacent engineering background

 - 4-5+ years in related areas — DevOps, IT, software engineering, or similar with concrete security responsibilities or overlap. Comfortable scripting/coding to build and automate your own tooling.

 - SIEM/observability experience: You've worked with logging, detection, or observability platforms in a cloud or distributed environment. The specific stack matters less than your understanding and approach.

 - Sound judgment on AI and automation: You're willing to implement AI and automation where it helps, and just as willing to recognize when a deterministic tool — or a human — is the better call.

 - Comfort with high autonomy: You thrive in an async, high-autonomy environment and can prioritize your own work without a lot of hand-holding.

 - Strong cross-functional collaboration: You work well with technical and non technical teams to understand detection and response needs and keep several projects moving at once.

 - Mission driven: You're motivated by Headway's mission of increasing access to high-quality mental healthcare.



Nice to have (optional, not required):

 - Experience in a regulated environment (e.g. healthcare, finance, federal)

 - Experience with automation/SOAR tooling

 - Detection-as-Code or Infrastructure-as-Code experience

 - A track record of prioritizing and shipping risk-based detections, running threat modeling, or building alert pipelines




COMPREHENSIVE BENEFITS:

Medical, dental, vision, HSA/FSA, 401(k) including match for 2027!, Carrot Fertility reimbursement, and paid parental, medical and caregiver leave.



We believe a team's strength is in its people, and we cannot achieve this mission without a team that reflects the diversity of this problem – across race, ethnicity, gender, sexuality, age, national origin, religion, family status, disability, military status, and experience. Headway is committed to the full inclusion of all qualified individuals. As part of this commitment, Headway will ensure that persons with disabilities are provided with reasonable accommodations. If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and/or receive other benefits and privileges of employment, please inform the recruiter when they contact you to schedule your interview.



Headway participates in E-Verify. To learn more, click here. https://www.e-verify.gov/sites/default/files/everify/posters/EVerifyParticipationPoster.pdf



A notice to Headway applicants: To protect yourself against phishing and recruitment fraud, please note that Headway only accepts applications through our official careers page at https://headway.co/careers. Headway will never refer you to external websites, ask for payment or personal information, or conduct interviews via messaging apps. All official communication will come from a @findheadway.com http://findheadway.com email address. If you are contacted by someone claiming to be from Headway via an unofficial channel, please do not share any information and report it as spam.

Our systems regularly process more than 12 billion emails during peak events like Black Friday, and our throughput requirements continue to scale rapidly. - Systems Mindset: Strong foundational background in computer science fundamentals, data structures, and building self-healing cloud architectures.

Desired:

About Tailscale

Tailscale is making safe connection effortless by delivering software that makes it easy to securely interconnect people and their devices, no matter where they are. From hobbyists to multinational corporations, teams of every size use Tailscale each day to protect their networks, share access to internal tools, and more. We're building a future for the Internet that's easy, sensible, and safe, like it used to be. Founded in 2019 and fully distributed, we're backed by Accel, CRV, Insight, Heavybit, and Uncork Capital.

About the Role

We're looking for an experienced full-stack Documentation Platform Engineer to evolve our documentation site into a platform that delivers an exceptional experience for Tailscale's prospective and current customers.

You'll build, maintain, evolve, and support the platform and tools that internal teams and external contributors use to showcase Tailscale's features and products. This includes the documentation platform itself, our content pipelines, API documentation, and search. You'll work on a highly-visible customer-facing documentation site and you'll influence how documentation gets created, published, and consumed.

Key Responsibilities

- Continuously improve and evolve our documentation site to create a helpful, delightful, and educational experience that helps homelabbers, developers, and enterprises (and their agents) get the most of out of Tailscale's products and features.

- Maintain and expand our docs-as-code tooling and content publishing pipelines, ensuring a smooth experience for both internal and external contributors to publish error-free content quickly.

- Partner with designers, user research, and growth teams to implement designs and features as they move from experimentation to production.

- Help shape and tune a modern search and discovery infrastructure to help visitors, and agents, discover answers quickly.

- Work with open source contributors through GitHub discussions, issues, and pull requests.

- Monitor the platform's performance and maintain scalability for millions of visitors per month.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Agent Auth
jobs.description:
About Vercel:

Vercel is the agentic infrastructure company, freeing people and agents to ship what's next. For more than a decade we've helped builders move from idea to production with speed, security, and exceptional developer experience.

Now we're scaling our products for both agents and people to ship and run software, built in the open and trusted by OpenAI, PayPal, Ramp, Supreme, and millions of developers worldwide.

About the role:

Agents are becoming first-class users of the internet. They sign in, call APIs, deploy code, and act on behalf of people and teams. That raises questions the web was never designed to answer: Who is this agent? Who does it work for? What is it allowed to do, for how long, and how do we know?

As an engineer on the Agent Auth and Identity team, you'll help answer those questions. You'll build the systems that let agents and people authenticate, delegate access, and act safely across Vercel and the services our customers connect to. This is foundational work: identity and authorization sit underneath everything we ship, and getting them right for agents will shape how modern software gets built.

The scope is intentionally broad. You might spend one quarter designing how credentials are issued and scoped for autonomous agents, and the next building the developer-facing APIs and SDKs that make secure auth feel effortless. You'll own systems end-to-end, from design through long-term operation in production.

We're looking for engineers who care deeply about security and developer experience in equal measure, enjoy working on problems without established playbooks, and want to define how trust works in an agentic world. This is a hybrid role based in San Francisco, in the office on Monday, Tuesday, and Friday.

What you'll do:

- Design, build, and operate the identity, authentication, and authorization systems that power Vercel and our Customers for both people and agents.

- Shape how agents prove who they are, act on behalf of users and teams, and receive scoped, time-bound, auditable access.

- Build secure, scalable APIs, services, and SDKs that make auth simple for developers and their agents to adopt.

- Work with modern and emerging standards (such as OAuth 2.x, OIDC, and agent-focused protocols) and help influence where they go next.

- Lead projects end-to-end: identify opportunities, set technical direction, and deliver improvements in security, reliability, and developer experience.

- Participate in the on-call rotation, taking responsibility for the reliability of critical systems.

What you need:

- 3+ years of experience designing, building, and operating backend systems in production at scale.

- Strong proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript, or a comparable backend language and the willingness to work primarily in TypeScript.

- Solid understanding of authentication and authorization concepts, such as sessions, tokens, OAuth/OIDC flows, permission models, and secrets management.

- A security-minded approach to engineering: you think about threat models, least privilege, and failure modes as part of design, not as an afterthought.

Benefits & Compensation:

- Competitive compensation package, including equity.

- Inclusive Healthcare Package.

- Learn and Grow: we provide mentorship and send you to events that help you build your network and skills.

- Flexible Time Off.

- We will provide you the gear you need to do your role, and a WFH budget for you to outfit your space as needed.

The base pay range for this role is $196,000 – $294,000. Actual salary will be based on job-related skills, experience, and location. The total compensation package may include benefits, equity-based compensation, and eligibility for a company bonus or variable pay program depending on the role. Your recruiter can share more details during the hiring process.

We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by law. jobs.description:
About Vercel:

Vercel is the agentic infrastructure company, freeing people and agents to ship what's next. For more than a decade we've helped builders move from idea to production with speed, security, and exceptional developer experience.

Now we're scaling our products for both agents and people to ship and run software, built in the open and trusted by OpenAI, PayPal, Ramp, Supreme, and millions of developers worldwide.

About the Role:

Vercel Connect helps developers give agents and AI-built apps secure access to the data, tools, and events they need—without wrestling with OAuth, credentials, and integration complexity. We’re currently building two things: 1) a platform for managing agent identity, access and permissions and 2) a set of rich connectors for the 1000s of systems (like Linear, Slack, GitHub, Google, etc.) that agents will need to talk to.

We’re solving core problems like agent identity and delegated access, tool approval and standards around making agents aware of changes on 3rd party platforms.

As a senior engineer on this team you'll not only own our APIs, token infrastructure, authorization, SDKs, and more, but work with external companies to make it easier for developers to build agents that integrate with their products. You’ll need to balance both high uptime and fast performance with flexibility to allow for seamless connection to many systems that weren’t designed with agents in mind. If you’re looking for a role that will put you at the center of how agent identity and credentials work, this is it! This is a hybrid role based in San Francisco, in the office on Monday, Tuesday, and Friday.

What You Will Do:

- Ship provider integrations end to end — auth flows, token exchange, app registration, and the configuration UI — from generic API-key and OAuth presets through bespoke cases like Snowflake Partner Connect, Slack manager apps, and Microsoft Entra.

- Own and improve our infrastructure (uptime, performance, secure storage of credentials and keys) and developer experience for Connect

- Work with industry leaders within and outside of Vercel to propose and implement new authentication and authorization protocols for AI era

- Build and harden event forwarding — signature verification inbound, project-scoped identity outbound, delivered to the right deployment and environment.

- Make Connect the obvious way to give an agent a credential, extending the SDKs , consent-redirect flow, and framework adapters.

- Reduce the cost of the next hundred integrations, so most new providers become configuration rather than code.

About You:

- 6+ years building and operating production backend or full-stack systems, with a track record of owning a service or platform surface rather than a feature.

- You deeply understand your users problems and work in a focused manner to address them, leveling up the product you’re working on over time.

- Deep, practical understanding of OAuth 2.0/2.1, OIDC, and JWTs — not just wiring up a client library, but reasoning about authorization codes, PKCE, refresh semantics, audience and scope restriction, token exchange, and what each of those actually protects against.

- A security instinct for integration code specifically — SSRF and DNS rebinding, confused-deputy and mix-up attacks, redirect-URI validation, webhook signature verification, tenant isolation. You've either found these bugs or fixed them.

- Strong TypeScript, and comfort developing backend and frontend components.

- Experience integrating with many third-party APIs, an appetite for the reality of it — undocumented behavior, non-compliant OAuth, inconsistent errors — and the judgment to absorb that mess behind a clean abstractions

jobs.title: Research Engineer, Benchmarks & Evaluation
jobs.description:
ABOUT RAMP

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.




ABOUT RAMP LABS

Ramp Labs is Ramp's AI research group. We post-train models on finance work, build the environments and evals they learn from, and ship them into the products 70,000+ companies use to move money. We think the defensible part of an AI product is the loop: proprietary environments, evals that track what customers care about, and models trained against both.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Every model decision at Ramp Labs runs through a benchmark. Which model to route to. Whether a post-training run worked. Whether an agent is ready to post a corrective journal entry to a customer's ledger without a human in the loop.

You'll own Ramp's benchmarking effort. You'll turn real finance work (expense policy review, invoice coding, month-end close, spreadsheet Q&A) into benchmarks and RL environments, build the graders, and tell the team what is actually improving.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Build benchmarks from real workflows: turn agent traces, customer edge cases and expert labels into versioned benchmark suites for long-horizon agents that run for hours across tools and systems, plus tool use, multi-step reasoning and financial judgment

 - Own the benchmarking effort: decide what we measure, run benchmark suites across models and agent versions, and report results the team makes decisions on

 - Design graders: rubrics, programmatic checks and llm-as-judge, calibrated against human agreement, with a clear view of where each one breaks

 - Close the loop with post-training: turn evals into reward functions and RL environments, and catch reward hacking and contamination before they ship

 - Publish external benchmarks and write-ups on how models perform at real finance work




WHAT YOU NEED

 - Hands-on experience building LLM benchmarks or evals that people used to make real decisions

 - Strong Python and software engineering; your eval code is reproducible and fast

 - Statistical judgment: variance, confidence intervals, sample size, inter-rater agreement, and knowing when a delta is noise

 - Working knowledge of post-training (SFT, RL with verifiable rewards) and how evals feed into it

 - Comfort with SQL and large datasets; you'll work directly from production traces

 - Taste for what is worth measuring




NICE-TO-HAVE

 - Industry experience on an eval, benchmarking or post-training team

 - Built RL environments or verifiers for agentic tasks

 - Published benchmark or evaluation research (NeurIPS Datasets & Benchmarks, ICML, ACL)

 - Built or contributed to eval frameworks (verifiers, lm-evaluation-harness, HELM or similar)

 - Familiarity with accounting, finance or other expert-domain work

 - Public work we can look at: a benchmark, an eval suite, a failure-analysis write-up




BENEFITS AVAILABLE TO ALL FULL-TIME RAMP EMPLOYEES (GLOBAL)

 - Flexible PTO

 - Centralized home-office equipment ordering

 - Health and wellness stipend

 - Budget for intra-office travel

 - Weekly coffee stipend




UNITED STATES

 - 100% medical, dental & vision insurance coverage for you, with partial coverage for dependents

 - One Medical annual membership

 - 401(k), including employer match on contributions made while employed by Ramp

 - Fertility HRA (up to $10,000 per year)

 - Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay

 - Pet insurance

 - In-office perks: lunch, snacks, drinks, and more

 - Relocation expense coverage to NYC or SF (if needed)
   
   


CANADA

 - Group medical, dental, and vision coverage through Sun Life

 - Life, AD&D, and disability coverage

 - Fertility drug coverage (up to $4,000 lifetime)

 - Group Retirement Plan with employer match (RRSP + DPSP)

 - Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay, with additional time available at reduced pay

 - Employee Assistance Program and virtual care through Lumino Health

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Big Data, Tech Enablement
jobs.description:
We offer a hybrid work environment. Most US-based positions can also be performed remotely (any exceptions will be noted in the Minimum Qualifications below.)

Our Mission:

To actively connect people to their next great opportunity.

Who We Are:

ZipRecruiter is a leading online employment marketplace. Powered by AI-driven smart matching technology, the company actively connects millions of all-sized businesses and job seekers through innovative mobile, web, and email services, as well as through partnerships with the best job boards on the web. ZipRecruiter has the #1 rated job search app on iOS & Android.

Summary:

The Tech Enablement team is central to the velocity and quality of our entire engineering organization. Our mission is to build the scalable, reliable, and efficient infrastructure, tools, and processes that allow every product team to quickly deliver innovative products and services to our customers.

The Tech Enablement team ensures engineering efficiency and provides the foundational building blocks for the entire technology stack:

- Data Infrastructure & Systems: We help developers at ZipRecruiter sustainably follow best practices and implement robust solutions by allowing engineers and data scientists to focus less on underlying technologies and more on building products and features that delight ZipRecruiter’s customers. To do this, the team builds, maintains, and drives adoption of tools for engineers that aid in data processing, dataset ingestion, dataset discoverability, data pipeline orchestration, data documentation, data analysis, building ML model pipelines, and running experiments.

- AI Enablement: We help developers at ZipRecruiter leverage AI as a part of their tech stack by building and maintaining an agentic AI data exploration and analysis tool to democratize access to data, collaborate on insights, and accelerate data driven decision making. Starting from a natural language chat interface, the AI assisted tool assists with every aspect of using data, from finding the right data sources and writing queries to using them to visualize and analyze the results. We also manage an LLM Gateway which powers all of ZipRecruiter’s LLM usage in our customer facing products.

Key Focuses:

As a Big Data Engineer in Tech Enablement, you will:

- Data Ingestion & Datalake Management: Design, build, deploy, and maintain the data pipelines and systems that make web events available in our datalake and via event streams for various downstream applications to process.

- Big Data Processing: You'll tackle challenges with large, evolving datasets, using a mix of batch and streaming techniques to make critical trade-offs between speed, efficiency, and reliability.

- MLOps: Design, build, deploy, and maintain frameworks and systems that accelerate ML development across teams and products at ZipRecruiter, with the goals of improving the velocity, quality, observability, and reliability of ML development and ML powered products.

- Data Documentation Framework: Design, build, deploy, and maintain frameworks and systems to improve the comprehensiveness and quality of data documentation at ZipRecruiter through processes and tooling that allows both humans and automated processes to easily add, maintain, and discover documentation.

- Data Analysis Agent: Design, build, deploy, and maintain an agentic data exploration and analysis tool, Sift, to democratize access to data, collaborate on insights, and accelerate data driven decision making.

Minimum Qualifications:

- 2+ years of professional software development experience, including building and operating data pipelines that feed into a customer facing product

- Hands-on Apache Spark experience: writing, tuning and debugging batch and/or streaming jobs at scale

- Experience deploying and operating containerized services and batch jobs

- Solid computer science fundamentals: data structures, algorithms, distributed systems, and testing

- Professional software development experience, including building and operating data pipelines and infrastructure that feed into a customer facing product

Preferred Qualifications:

- 4+ years of professional software development experience with a focus on data-intensive systems

- Working knowledge of AWS (S3, IAM, EC2, MSK or equivalents) and of instrumenting jobs with metrics, logs and alerts

- Experience with a data lake stack: parquet on object storage, a data catalog such as AWS Glue, and an open table format such as Apache Iceberg or Delta Lake

- Streaming experience: Kafka producers and consumers, Apache Flink, and/or Spark Structured Streaming

- Experience with a workflow orchestrator such as Apache Airflow: authoring DAGs, backfills, dependency management and on-call for scheduled pipelines

- Experience with open table format internals: schema evolution, partitioning, and compaction

- Experience with deploying services on Kubernetes with Docker

- Experience building and maintaining a data platform that powers a user-facing product including infrastructure and tools for streaming and batch data ingestion, building ETL pipelines, data permissions management, and data discovery.

- BS/MS/PhD in Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

As part of our team you’ll enjoy:

- Competitive compensation

- Exceptional benefits package

- Flexible Vacation & Paid Time Off

- Employer-matched 401(k) plan

The US base salary range for this full-time position is $135,000 - $185,000. Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location, and the range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salaries for the position across all US locations. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location, role-related knowledge and skills, depth of experience, relevant education or training, and additional role-related considerations.

Depending on the position offered, equity, bonuses, commission, or other forms of compensation may also be provided as part of a total compensation package, in addition to a full range of medical, financial, and other benefits.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Infrastructure Engineering
jobs.description:
Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com.

The Infrastructure Engineering team enables Reddit to deliver Reliability, Performance, and Efficiency, with a single opinionated technology stack. We empower Reddit developers by delivering a reliable, scalable, and automated foundation - unifying compute, seamless deployments, robust storage, and high-performance messaging to maximize developer velocity and system resilience.

This centralized role hires across several high-impact teams, including:

- Messaging: Delivers a reliable, performant, and efficient platform to support asynchronous communication across all products and services at Reddit.

- Site Defense: Builds platforms that detect and mitigate bots, scraping, and abusive traffic while preserving a reliable experience for legitimate users across Reddit.

- Infrastructure Security: Builds platforms for service identity, secrets management, and secure access that make Reddit’s infrastructure secure by default.

What You’ll Do

- Cross-Functional Product Architecture: Partner closely with Product Management, Product Design, Data Science, and Client Engineers (iOS/Android/Web) to translate business and user needs into reliable, low-latency technical solutions.

- End-to-End Delivery: Own the full software lifecycle for major product initiatives from technical design docs and API contracts to development, testing, rollout, and observability.

- Metrics & Experimentation-Led Engineering: Design, build, and evaluate A/B experiments. Work with tools like BigQuery, HEX, or Firebase to analyze user behavior, conversion funnels, and retention loops to make data-backed engineering decisions.

- API & System Performance: Build and maintain scalable APIs (GraphQL, REST, gRPC) and distributed backend services optimized for client consumption and consumer UI performance.

- Technical Rigor & Modern Tooling: Establish engineering best practices, improve developer workflows, mentor teammates, and use modern, AI-integrated tools to ship high-quality products efficiently.

In your day-to-day, you will:

- Steer: Work with the team to select, scope, and drive high leverage projects that align with Reddit’s goals.

- Build: Execute on a strategy and create a more performant, more scalable, higher quality architecture around authentication, authorization and identity.

- Amplify: Mentor, coach, and collaborate with other technical contributors

- Collaborate: Work together with a variety of cross functional teams across Reddit Engineering.

- Evolve: Learn and improve your own technical and non-technical abilities

Who you might be:

- 3+ years of experience building internet-scale software, preferably with a focus on distributed systems infrastructure or infrastructure security.

- Software development experience in one or more general purpose programming languages; Golang, Python, C++, Java

- Experience with essential cloud infrastructure (Kubernetes, CI/CD, AWS, GCP)

- Hands-on experience implementing features, optimizations, and bug fixes to distributed messaging systems.

- Excellent communication skills to collaborate with stakeholders in engineering, data science, machine learning, and product.

- Degree in Computer Science or equivalent technical field.

Benefits:

- Comprehensive Healthcare Benefits and Income Replacement Programs

- 401k with Employer Match

- Global Benefit programs that fit your lifestyle, from workspace to professional development to caregiving support

- Family Planning Support

- Gender-Affirming Care

- Mental Health & Coaching Benefits

- Flexible Vacation & Paid Volunteer Time Off

- Generous Paid Parental Leave

Pay Transparency:

This job posting may span more than one career level.

In addition to base salary, this job is eligible to receive equity in the form of restricted stock units, and depending on the position offered, it may also be eligible to receive a commission. Additionally, Reddit offers a wide range of benefits to U.S.-based employees, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) program with employer match, generous time off for vacation, and parental leave. To learn more, please visit https://www.redditinc.com/careers/.
