jobs.title: Data Center Electrical Engineer – Design
jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Training and serving frontier AI models requires compute infrastructure at a scale and density that pushes past what conventional data center designs were built to handle. Anthropic's Data Center Infrastructure team is responsible for delivering that physical infrastructure — partnering with build partners, equipment manufacturers, and utilities to stand up facilities that can reliably power some of the largest accelerator clusters in the industry.

As a Data Center Electrical Engineer – Design, you'll own the electrical architecture of our facilities from the utility service entrance through to the rack — substation interface, medium- and high-voltage distribution, on-site generation and storage integration, UPS, switchgear, busway, and rack power. You'll develop and maintain the basis of design, reference architectures, and technical specifications that our build partners and A/E firms design against, and you'll be the point of technical authority when their drawings and calculations come back for review. You'll run the engineering studies — short-circuit, protection coordination, arc flash, load flow, and power quality — and you'll keep the architecture ahead of rapidly increasing rack densities and the unique load characteristics of large-scale ML training.

A central part of this role is speed-to-capacity through prefabrication: you'll shape Anthropic's offsite-manufactured electrical strategy — modular skids, e-houses, and prefabricated power assemblies — and drive its standardization across sites. You'll work closely with colleagues across the infrastructure team, with our hardware and compute teams to translate accelerator requirements into electrical design criteria, and with supply chain to qualify and diversify regional equipment vendors. Expect roughly 10–25% travel for design reviews, partner and vendor meetings, factory witness testing, and site visits to support commissioning and startup.

Responsibilities

Electrical design & engineering

-

Lead the electrical design of critical data center infrastructure across the US portfolio, including the utility interface and substation, site medium- and high-voltage distribution, generators, UPS, switchgear, transformers, busway, and grounding

-

Develop and maintain Anthropic's electrical basis of design, reference architectures, and technical specifications for critical power distribution — covering switchgear, UPS systems, PDUs, busway, and rack power delivery — producing designs that meet our reliability and maintainability requirements while staying within budgetary targets

-

Perform and validate engineering studies — including short-circuit, protection coordination, arc flash, load flow, and power quality analysis — and use the findings to steer topology, redundancy, equipment-selection, and protection-setting decisions

-

Design and plan data center hall power distribution layouts for newly allocated spaces in coordination with the telecom, mechanical and cooling design

Prefabrication & modular delivery

-

Drive Anthropic's prefabricated and modular electrical strategy — developing modular skids, e-houses, and prefabricated power assemblies, and partnering with external engineering and manufacturing teams on a productization roadmap that accelerates deployment and reduces onsite labor

-

Design for offsite manufacture and onsite assembly: define the interfaces between prefabricated components and site-built work, and the electrical interfaces and switchover points for temporary-to-permanent power sequencing

-

Drive standardization of modular electrical designs across sites to compress deployment timelines while preserving flexibility for site-specific constraints and evolving hardware generations

Partner, vendor & utility coordination

-

Work with regional vendors and manufacturers to specify and qualify major electrical equipment, and partner with supply chain to build a diversified vendor base that mitigates lead-time and single-source risk

-

Work with utilities and interconnection/transmission operators (e.g., ISOs/RTOs) to define site utility service and interconnection requirements, and with local authorities having jurisdiction to ensure designs comply with the National Electrical Code (NFPA 70/NEC), NFPA, IEEE, UL/ANSI, and local requirements

-

Work with Anthropic's hardware and compute teams to translate accelerator power, density, and power-quality requirements into electrical design criteria, and keep the reference architecture aligned with upcoming hardware generations

-

Present findings and design positions to internal stakeholders, build partners, and operations teams through clear reports and presentations, and defend them under challenge

Design review & quality

-

Review and approve electrical design packages, calculations, submittals, and shop drawings from build partners and MEP consultants; track clarifications, deviations, and exceptions against the basis of design, and hold the line on capacity, reliability, maintainability, and safety requirements

-

Perform technical due diligence and design reviews on data center developer and partner projects — evaluating their electrical single-lines, equipment selections, studies, and specifications against Anthropic's reliability, maintainability, and capacity requirements

-

Define project electrical scope and serve as the design authority on RFIs and field changes that affect design intent during procurement and construction

-

Support factory acceptance testing, commissioning, and startup — reviewing test procedures and results against design intent, participating on site for key milestones, and closing as-built changes back into the reference design

-

Manage concurrent projects across multiple geographies

-

Continuously improve Anthropic's internal electrical design standards, tooling, and delivery practices, and act as a technical leader within the engineering group and across the internal and external teams that support our data centers

You may be a good fit if you

-

Have 10+ years of electrical engineering experience in mission-critical facilities, with substantial time spent on data center or other high-availability electrical distribution design — from concept through construction documents and into commissioning support

-

Have deep familiarity with US electrical codes and standards — including the National Electrical Code (NFPA 70/NEC), NFPA 70E, IEEE standards (e.g., 1584 for arc flash), and UL/ANSI equipment standards (e.g., UL 891, UL 1558) — and with utility interconnection processes

-

Have hands-on experience producing and reviewing electrical construction documents, single-line diagrams, and equipment specifications, and can interpret data center floor plans and technical layouts with confidence

-

Have strong knowledge of power distribution and cooling infrastructure in high-availability data center environments

-

Are fluent in power systems analysis and comfortable running or critically reviewing studies in tools such as SKM, ETAP, or EasyPower

-

Understand critical power topologies (2N, N+1, distributed redundant, block redundant) and can articulate the trade-offs between them for different reliability and cost targets

-

Have working knowledge of HV/MV substations, on-site generation, and energy storage integration, and how each shapes the overall electrical architecture

-

Have hands-on experience with prefabricated and modular data center electrical infrastructure — design for offsite manufacture, modular skids/e-houses, and the interfaces between prefabricated components and onsite assembly

-

Have worked directly with electrical equipment manufacturers, A/E consultants, and contractors, and can evaluate products and designs on technical merit, not just datasheet claims

-

Hold a bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or a closely related field, or have equivalent practical experience; Professional Engineer (PE) licensure is valued but not required

-

Communicate clearly with both technical peers and non-specialist stakeholders, and are comfortable defending a design position under scrutiny from partners and internal reviewers

Strong candidates may also have

-

Experience owning the electrical basis of design or reference architecture for a hyperscale or large colocation program, and driving its adoption across multiple sites or by external build partners

-

A track record building modular prefabricated products in the electrical or mechanical scope of a data center, and driving designs toward offsite manufacturing

-

Background in medium-/high-voltage distribution, on-site generation, or battery energy storage system (BESS) integration, and how those shape the building-side electrical design

-

Exposure to liquid-cooled infrastructure and its implications for electrical room layout and load distribution

-

Prior work at a hyperscaler, colocation provider, or MEP consultancy serving large data center clients

-

Direct project experience delivering data centers in multiple US markets (e.g., Virginia, Texas, Arizona, Ohio, Oregon)

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:

$320,000—$405,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on beha

jobs.title: Software Engineer, ERP Applications & Development
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

About The Job

ERP Technology builds and runs the custom applications and integrations that keep Anduril's Finance, Supply Chain, and Manufacturing operations moving at the pace that our mission demands. Our Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP platform is the backbone of those operations, but standard ERP functionality doesn't cover everything the business needs. That gap is where this role lives.

As a Software Engineer on ERP Technology, you will design, build, and maintain the internal tools, backend services, and APIs that extend what Fusion can do out of the box. You'll work alongside ERP product teams spanning Finance, Supply Chain, Accounting, Manufacturing, and more, and across the systems the ERP ecosystem touches, including Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), enterprise data platforms, and the business applications those teams depend on. Your job is to turn ambiguous requirements into software that holds up in production, not just in a demo.

This role calls for strong software engineering fundamentals, confidence operating in a complex enterprise environment, and the judgment to know when to build, when to integrate, and when to automate.

What You'll Do

- Design, build, test, deploy, and maintain custom applications, internal tools, and backend services supporting the ERP ecosystem.

- Translate business requirements from ERP product teams into software solutions.

- Build applications and services that talk to Oracle Fusion and connected enterprise platforms via REST APIs and other supported integration methods.

- Partner with Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC) developers to keep new applications compatible with established integration architecture, and support design and testing of solutions touching financial, supply chain, procurement, and manufacturing systems.

- Implement authentication, authorization, error handling, logging, and monitoring that meets production standards.

- Identify opportunities to replace manual work with solutions and automation, including tools for data validation, reconciliation, workflow orchestration, and operational reporting.

- Own ongoing engineering support and reliability for applications in your portfolio: diagnose defects, build automated testing and monitoring, and maintain technical documentation and runbooks.

- Partner with ERP technical and functional teams, Product Managers, Enterprise Architecture, OIC developers, ERP administrators, and Security to deliver end-to-end solutions that meet real operational needs.

- Participate in technical design reviews, code reviews, and continuous improvement of how the team builds and ships software.

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or equivalent practical experience.

- 3+ years of professional software development experience.

- Strong programming skills in one or more of: Python, Java, JavaScript, or TypeScript.

- Experience building standalone applications, backend services, internal tools, or enterprise software.

- Experience designing and consuming REST APIs, and working with JSON, XML, and related data formats.

- Experience with SQL, relational databases, and data processing.

- Working familiarity with modern development frameworks, Git, CI/CD pipelines, and automated testing.

- Experience with cloud-based application development or deployment.

- Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to operate in a complex, cross-functional enterprise environment.

Preferred Qualifications

jobs.description:
At Render, we’re building the modern cloud platform for developers creating AI-native, full-stack, multi-service applications. Our mission is to eliminate the tradeoff between the power of hyperscalers and the simplicity of developer-friendly platforms—so teams can ship fast, scale reliably, and focus on their product, not infrastructure.

Unlike complex hyperscalers or ephemeral edge/serverless solutions, Render offers a developer-first experience with persistent compute, dynamic autoscaling, built-in orchestration, and observability, allowing teams to launch, scale, and manage real-world applications without writing infrastructure code or managing servers. Whether you're building LLM-powered applications, scalable SaaS products, or async processing pipelines, Render empowers teams to move fast and scale confidently from MVP to millions of users.

Our platform is trusted by over 7 million developers worldwide and continues to grow rapidly. In February 2026, we raised an additional $100M in Series C financing, bringing our total funding to $260M, to accelerate our vision of making cloud infrastructure both powerful and intuitive—designed for the speed of modern AI development.

We’re a diverse and talented team that values craft, velocity, and user experience. If you’re excited to help shape the future of the intelligent cloud and empower developers everywhere, we’d love to hear from you.




APPLYING TO RENDER

We're seeking candidates who possess high integrity, humility, and an insatiable drive to learn. Through reasoned discussions and continuous feedback, we strive to improve both individually and collectively. We foster an environment of mutual trust and respect, empowering effective debate to achieve the best outcomes for our customers and team.

We especially encourage members of underrepresented groups in the tech community to apply and understand that not all successful candidates will meet each requirement listed.

Our interview process is unique to each role, and we value the candidate experience just as much as our customer experience. We hope your conversations with us reflect a thoughtful process that is illuminative, enjoyable, and respectful of your time.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Render's mission is to eliminate the undifferentiated work that goes into building software products by offering an easy-to-use, powerful cloud platform for developer teams of all sizes.

We are scaling rapidly. Our customers have created hundreds of thousands of services on our platform, and the numbers continue to accelerate. Our customers trust us to deliver a secure, reliable and performant cloud — this is our top priority as a company.

By joining us at an early stage, you will design and build the cloud platform you've always wanted for yourself, and make decisions that will shape our product and company, directly impacting developers around the globe.

Render builds and operates our own networking stack end-to-end. We leverage open source and industry-standard technologies, modifying and extending the core components to meet the unique reliability, performance, and scaling demands of our platform.

We are looking for engineers with deep specialization in network infrastructure, particularly with experience in edge/ingress networking and Kubernetes networking internals.

Areas of focus include scaling and evolving our traffic routing and load balancing systems; advancing Kubernetes and Linux networking components to support large-scale, zero-downtime operation; and exploring networking for Render’s next-generation compute platforms.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own Render's core network infrastructure across multiple data centers and cloud providers. Shape how networking evolves as Render rapidly scales.

 - Design and build customer-facing networking capabilities that give users greater flexibility in how their services connect, communicate, and how traffic is routed.

 - Investigate complex networking issues across the stack, from the kernel and data plane to distributed systems and edge networking.

 - Drive performance and reliability improvements through systematic profiling and tuning.

 - Partner with engineers across the company to build a platform that is stable, predictable, and secure.

 - Participate in our on-call rotation. Help continuously improve how we detect, respond to, and learn from incidents.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - At least 6 years of experience building and operating large-scale networking or infrastructure systems.

 - Experience with Kubernetes networking internals (e.g. kube-proxy, CNI plugins, service routing) or similar container networking technology.

 - Experience with Linux networking internals (e.g. routing, netfilter/iptables/nftables, conntrack) in production environments.

 - Experience building and operating traffic routing systems (e.g. load balancers, ingress, proxies) at scale.

 - Strong experience designing, debugging, and operating distributed systems.

 - Experience planning and executing high-risk changes with minimal downtime.


NICE-TO-HAVES

 - Experience with eBPF or advanced Linux kernel networking.

 - Experience developing systems in Go or similar languages that interact with low-level OS and networking primitives.


RELEVANT LINKS FROM THE RENDER ENGINEERING TEAM

 - The Namespaces Scaling Trap https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NCKhoYsNsmE (video podcast interview) and related article How We Found 7 TiB of Memory Just Sitting Around https://render.com/blog/how-we-found-7-tib-of-memory-just-sitting-around

 - Breaking down OpenAI's outage: How to avoid a hidden DNS dependency in Kubernetes https://render.com/blog/a-hidden-dns-dependency-in-kubernetes

 - Kubernetes Informers are so easy... to misuse! https://render.com/blog/kubernetes-informers

If this role excites you but you don’t meet every single requirement, we’d still love to hear from you—your unique experience might be just what we need.




BENEFITS

 - 4 weeks of paid vacation.

 - 14 weeks of fully paid parental leave for all parents to bond with a newly born, adopted, or fostered child. We will also work with you to create a supportive plan of return.

 - Long-term disability, life insurance, and 401K plans.

 - 100% employer-paid medical coverage and 99% employer-paid dental and vision coverage for you and a dependent. FSAs and HSAs are available as well.

 - Monthly lifestyle stipend for wellness, mental health and therapy, hobbies, etc.

 - Monthly cell phone and internet subsidy.

 - Commuter benefits for Renders in the Bay Area, and home office stipends for remote Renders.

 - Continuous learning benefits & related support.

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer 2
jobs.description:
Who we are

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.
.

Hiring and how we work

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.
.

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as Twilio’s next Machine Learning Engineer, Customer Memory.

About the job

This position is needed to build and scale the pipelines that turn raw conversation data into structured, searchable customer memory, and the evaluation systems that keep that memory accurate as the product evolves.

You'll join the Conversation Memory team, which builds the memory layer behind Twilio's Conversational AI platform: the systems that extract what matters from millions of conversations, resolve it to the right customer, and retrieve it in milliseconds when an agent needs it. Memory that is wrong, stale, or crossed between customers is worse than no memory at all, so quality measurement is a first-class part of the work.

Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll:

- Build the extraction pipeline that turns raw data into structured memory, tuning the LLM prompts and schemas that decide what an AI agent remembers about a customer and what it forgets.

- Own the retrieval path that answers "what do we know about this person?" in milliseconds, working with embeddings, vector search, and ranking

- Contribute to the eval systems that tell us whether memory is actually getting better, turning a fuzzy question of quality into benchmarks and regression gates that run before every change ships.

- Diagnose production issues across the ingestion, extraction, and indexing path using logs, metrics, and traces.

- Partner with Product and ML teams to translate customer problems into system changes and evaluation criteria.

Qualifications

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

Required:

- Experience building backend services, and a demonstrated ability to pick up new languages, frameworks, and tools as the problem demands.

- A curious approach to service management: ability to investigate how systems actually behave in production, and desire to continuously learn how to operate them with rigor and accountability.

- Experience building or working with evaluation/quality-measurement systems, such as regression detection or quality metrics, or the desire to learn.

- Solid grounding in observability practices: structured logging, metrics, and using them to debug distributed systems in production.

- Fluency with AI-assisted dev tools (e.g. agents for code generation, review, debugging), applied with deliberate direction and critical thinking.

Desired:

- Experience with Go and/or Python.

- Experience with event-streaming systems (e.g. Kafka).

- Experience building LLM-backed products.

- Practical experience applying ML, e.g. building, evaluating, or productionizing models.

Location

- This role will be remote, but is not eligible to be hired in San Francisco, CA, Oakland, CA, San Jose, CA, or the surrounding areas.

Travel

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, you may be required to travel occasionally to participate in project or team in-person meetings.

What We Offer

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.

Compensation

*Please note the salary range information provided applies only to candidates residing in California, Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, Minnesota, New Jersey, New York, Vermont, Washington D.C., and Washington State due to local requirements. Compensation for candidates in other locations will be discussed during the hiring process. Please note that hiring for this role is not restricted to the locations listed above.

The estimated pay ranges for this role are as follows:

- Based in New York, New Jersey, Washington State, or California (outside of the San Francisco Bay area): $136,000 - $170,000.

- This role may be eligible to participate in Twilio’s equity plan and corporate bonus plan. All roles are generally eligible for the following benefits: health care insurance, 401(k) retirement account, paid sick time, paid personal time off, paid parental leave.

The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location.

Application deadline information

Applications for this role are intended to be accepted until November 13, 2026 but may change based on business needs.

Twilio thinks big. Do you?

We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic. Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.

So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions.

.

Stay alert to recruitment fraud

jobs.title: Data Engineer, Product
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Notion's mission is to make toolmaking ubiquitous—from wikis and documents to notes, tasks, and databases. Strong product intuition and user focus have driven adoption across organizations of all sizes. Millions of users now rely on Notion's building blocks to get work done.

As Notion scales, there's a unique opportunity to build the data foundations that help our product and company reach their full potential. You'll design and build reliable, trusted datasets that accelerate decision-making across product and business functions, directly impacting our roadmap and growth.

This role is based in our San Francisco Headquarters. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Define ETL processes and infrastructure to make data readily available across the company

 - Build core datasets as single sources of truth for product and business teams (product, marketing, sales, finance, customer experience, data science, operations, IT, engineering)

 - Partner with data scientists and stakeholders to understand their needs and design, build, and monitor pipelines that scale with our growing data

 - Implement automated workflows that reduce operational costs, define SLAs for timely data delivery, and democratize data through self-serve dashboards, discovery tools, and AI-enabled exploration




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING:

 - Self-starter who gathers high-impact needs from business partners, designs technical solutions, and communicates clearly about deliverables, timelines, and tradeoffs

 - 5+ years of experience as a data engineer building core datasets and supporting business functions, with a passion for analytics, data modeling, and solving complex problems

 - Strong understanding of scalable cloud data solutions (AWS, GCP, Azure) across multiple data stores (Snowflake, Redshift, Hive, SQL/NoSQL, columnar formats) and methodologies (dimensional modeling, data marts, schemas)

 - SQL expert, proficient with aggregation, window functions, UDFs, self-joins, and optimization techniques for writing correct, high-performance queries

 - Highly comfortable with object-oriented programming (Python, Java, Scala)

 - Expert at using AI and agent-based tools to accelerate data development for yourself and others, including defining guardrails, workflows, and context for safe, production-scale data work
   
   


NICE TO HAVES:

 - Experience at a fast-scaling or SaaS company, with enthusiasm to contribute in such an environment (current Notion users especially welcome)

 - Hands-on experience designing and building highly scalable, reliable data pipelines using BigData stack tools (e.g., Airflow, DBT, Spark, Hive, Parquet/ORC, Protobuf/Thrift)
   
   

Our customers come from all walks of life and so do we. We hire great people from a wide variety of backgrounds, not just because it's the right thing to do, but because it makes our company stronger. If you share our values and our enthusiasm for small businesses, you will find a home at Notion.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation made due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. jobs.title: Software Engineer II, Autonomous Freight Technology
jobs.description:
About Flexport:

At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year.

The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.

The Opportunity

Join our engineering team in Bellevue building and enhancing Flexport’s client-facing rates platform and self-serve freight booking experience. You will work alongside experienced engineers and have direct ownership of features that move the company from an assisted-sales model to a tech-run one for the long tail of our client base.

This team owns two of the highest-leverage surfaces in the Client App: how clients see pricing and how they book without manual intervention. Rates sit at the center of every freight decision, and you will build the systems that power rate visibility, quoting, and pricing intelligence across our ocean business. You will also help build the infrastructure that integrates AI-powered automation into the booking flow. This is a rare opportunity to build the "front door" of an $8.6 trillion industry, turning the complexity of global trade into a seamless digital experience for thousands of shippers.

You Will

- Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain systems within a microservices architecture that power rate visibility and autonomous booking.

- Own the entire lifecycle of a feature: from database schema design and scalable backend APIs to building the React-based frontend applications our customers use.

- Support the integration of AI models and automated workflows to make the pricing and booking experience increasingly intelligent.

- Collaborate with engineering, product, and design to translate complex business problems into elegant, production-ready technical solutions.

- Contribute to code reviews to maintain high quality standards, share knowledge, and mentor peer engineers.

- Build highly available, secure, and distributed systems that can scale with Flexport’s global volume.

- Rapidly build and launch products incrementally, leveraging best practices around CI/CD and shipping to production dozens of times per day.

- Ensure high-quality standards by incorporating metrics, monitoring, and applying learnings from post-mortems to all services.

You Should Have

- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

- 3+ years of professional software engineering experience with a proven track record of shipping production-grade applications.

- Full-Stack Capability: You are comfortable owning a feature from end-to-end: working with databases, backend services (Java/Ruby), and frontend frameworks (React).

- Technical Rigor: A passion for simple, well-tested code that is easy to extend and hard to break.

- AI Familiarity: Experience or interest in working with AI APIs and building software that leverages machine learning models to automate user tasks.

- 2+ years of design and architecture knowledge as well as familiarity with object-oriented analysis and design patterns.

- Proficiency with modern programming languages: specifically Java, Ruby, or TypeScript.

- Proficiency with deploying, monitoring, and maintaining production services on cloud infrastructure (AWS).

It’s a Plus If You Have

- Experience with elements of our tech stack: Java, Spring Boot, Ruby on Rails, React, AWS.

- Experience in fintech, pricing engines, or booking systems.

- Experience in logistics, supply chain, or freight technology.

- A bias for action: When you see a problem, you fix it.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills: you can convey technical ideas in common terms to business stakeholders and product managers.

jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

DATA ENGINEER, MARKETING

The Data team at SpaceXSI is a small team that works across the company to inform business and product decisions, and we're hiring the first member of our team to focus fully on marketing. Performance Marketing at SpaceXSI drives scaled acquisition across 10+ channels for Grok, Grok Bot, and our full portfolio of AI products, across consumer, SMB, startup, and enterprise audiences.

This role will sit in the central Data team and partner directly with Marketing leadership to own the measurement and analysis of performance marketing, growth marketing programs, and overall marketing measurement. You'll use your expertise to inform where the next dollar goes as we scale paid acquisition, while building the foundations of a world class marketing data team. Your job is to help us understand the impact of our activities and what we should do next.



RESPONSIBILITIES:

 - Build and own the measurement layer for performance marketing: economics and performance by channel, campaign, audience, geo, and creative, across both PLG and Sales-Led revenue lines

 - Design incrementality tests (geo, audience, and conversion lift) with channel owners, and use the results to move budget and calibrate attribution, not just to fill a slide

 - Stand up and maintain our media-mix model, and pair it with test results to answer the big allocation questions: which channels to scale, which to cut, and where we're hitting saturation

 - Own the quality of the predictive LTV signal we send to Meta, Google, and the other networks: validate it against realized revenue, catch drift and breakage early, and partner with Data and Engineering to improve it

 - Keep pipeline source and campaign attribution separate and clean, so self-reported source, promo codes, click-based attribution, and CRM pipeline each answer their own question without double counting revenue

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

 - 5+ years of experience in marketing analytics, marketing science, or data science supporting paid acquisition

 - Strong SQL and Python skills

 - Experience building data pipelines and predictive models, such as LTV or conversion-value models

 - Familiarity with incrementality or holdout tests

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

 - Experience building and running media-mix models and multi-touch or click-based attribution in production, and a clear view of where each one falls short

 - Deep familiarity with how ad platforms (Meta, Google, and others) report, optimize, and ingest conversion signals, and a healthy skepticism of platform-reported numbers

 - Experience at a company with significant paid marketing spend, ideally during a period of rapid growth

 - Experience measuring both self-serve (PLG) and sales-led funnels

 - Clear communication with non-technical partners and honesty about what the data does and doesn't support

 - Comfortable owning ambiguous problems end to end as a first or early hire



COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

$220,000 - $275,000 USD

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Mixpanel is the leading product intelligence and analytics platform, trusted by more than 29,000 companies to help understand how people use the products they build. By combining powerful analytics with AI that knows your business, Mixpanel helps teams see what’s working, diagnose what’s not, and decide what to build next. Learn more at mixpanel.com.

About the Team

The Growth Engineering team at Mixpanel is responsible for increasing user activation and driving self-serve revenue. We work closely with Product, Design, and Marketing to grow the funnel of customers landing on our platform, implementing Mixpanel, and seeing value fast. We move fast, experiment constantly, and measure everything.

Within growth: this role is for the Top of Funnel Pod, a small crew specifically targeting user acquisition and activation. Some examples of what we’ve shipped lately:

- Agentic onboarding

- Experiment: Home page new feature product setup nudges

- Experiment: MCP connection

About the Role

As a Software Engineer on the Growth team, you will build and optimize the experiences that drive user acquisition, activation, and conversion at Mixpanel. A key focus of this role is web experimentation — you'll design, implement, and analyze experiments across our product onboarding flows and other surface areas to improve key growth metrics. You'll work across the full stack, from frontend UI changes to backend data pipelines, and collaborate with Product and Design to turn experiment insights into product improvements. This is a high-impact role where your work directly influences Mixpanel's top-of-funnel growth and self-serve revenue.

Responsibilities

- Design, build, and analyze experiments across Mixpanel's product and onboarding flows to optimize acquisition and activation metrics

- Partner with Product and Design to identify high-impact experiment hypotheses grounded in data and user research

- Instrument tracking and build dashboards (in Mixpanel!) to measure experiment outcomes and inform iteration

- Build and improve onboarding experiences that drive down time to value, and increase activation rates for new Mixpanel users

- Participate in team on-call rotation to improve our systems and keep them healthy

We're Looking For Someone Who Has

- At least 2 years of full-stack software engineering experience

- Excellent debugging and technical investigation skills

- Comfort using modern AI coding tools

- Experience running growth experimentation

- Strong technical communication, ideally with experience collaborating in an asynchronous remote environment

- Ability to move fast and iterate — you take ownership of problems and focus on delivering value to users

- A data-driven mindset

Bonus Points For

- Interest in leveraging AI/GenAI to accelerate experimentation workflows

- Prior experience on a growth engineering team or in a growth-focused role

- React / TypeScript experience

Culture Values

- Champion the Customer: We seek to deeply understand our customers’ needs, ensuring their success is our north star.

Why choose Mixpanel?

We’re a leader in analytics with over 29,000 customers and $277M invested from prominent investors: like Andreessen-Horowitz, Sequoia, YC, and, most recently, Bain Capital. Mixpanel’s pioneering event-based data analytics platform offers a powerful yet simple solution for companies to understand user behaviors and easily track overarching company success metrics. Our accomplished teams continuously facilitate our expansion by tackling the ever-evolving challenges tied to scaling, reliability, design, and service. Choosing to work at Mixpanel means you’ll be helping the world’s most innovative companies learn from their data so they can make better decisions.

As an AI Engineer, Internal Tools, you’ll work directly with teams across Figma to identify high-value AI opportunities and take them to production, moving from understanding a business workflow, to rapidly prototyping an approach, to evaluating it and integrating it with the systems and data needed to make it useful in the real world.

This isn’t a role focused only on building AI demos: you’ll own solutions through production, help determine where AI adds value and where traditional rules-based software is the right choice, and shape how agents can safely take actions across enterprise systems. As common patterns emerge, you’ll partner with our Platform & Tooling and Infrastructure teams to build reusable capabilities that make future AI builds faster and safer.

This is a full time role that can be held from one of our US hubs or remotely in the United States.

What you’ll do at Figma:

- Partner directly with teams across GTM, Finance, People, Legal, Support, and other business functions to understand workflows and identify high-value opportunities for AI

- Design, build, and productionize AI agents, assistants, and workflow automations that solve real business problems using LLMs, tool calling, RAG, structured outputs, agent frameworks, MCP, APIs, and enterprise data

- Integrate AI applications with enterprise systems and data sources across GTM, Finance, People, Support, and internal APIs

- Build evaluations and feedback loops to measure accuracy, reliability, and business impact before and after AI solutions reach production

- Design deterministic guardrails, human-in-the-loop controls, and approval patterns for workflows where AI systems take business-critical actions

- Build production-ready systems with strong observability, failure handling, security, authentication, authorization, and auditability

- Identify reusable patterns across individual AI projects and build them out as shared components and capabilities in partnership with our Internal AI platform teams

- Help define how Figma approaches Applied AI engineering and scales AI adoption across the company

We’d love to hear from you if you have:

- 5+ years of software engineering experience building production applications, integrations, backend systems, or AI-powered products

- Hands-on experience building applications with LLMs, agents, retrieval-augmented generation, function calling, schema-constrained outputs, or evaluation frameworks

- Experience taking an AI application or workflow beyond a prototype and operating it in a production environment

- Strong API, integration, and system design fundamentals, with experience connecting applications across multiple systems and data sources and strong engineering judgment about when to apply AI and when a rules-based approach is the right choice, and experience designing reliable production systems with appropriate observability, failure handling, authentication, authorization, and security controls

- Experience working directly with non-engineering stakeholders to understand ambiguous business problems and translate them into technical solutions and ability to move quickly from discovery to prototype while understanding what is required to safely and reliably productionize a solution

While it’s not required, it’s an added plus if you also have:

- A background building internal AI applications or working in an Applied AI, Forward Deployed Engineering, or AI Solutions Engineering role

- Experience with MCP, agent orchestration frameworks, and enterprise tool-calling patterns

- Knowledge of AWS Bedrock, AgentCore, OpenAI, Anthropic, or similar AI platforms

- Experience integrating enterprise systems such as Salesforce, Zendesk, Workday, NetSuite, Greenhouse, or Slack

- Knowledge of with AI evaluations, observability, prompt/version management, and human-in-the-loop systems

- Experience implementing enterprise identity and access patterns such as Okta, SSO, OAuth, and secure service-to-service authentication, within Security, Privacy, SOX/ITGC, or other enterprise governance requirements

jobs.title: Software Engineer II - CIAM
jobs.description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

Affirm is building the next generation of customer identity and authentication. This role is a hands-on, mid-engineering position inside Information Security, contributing to core CIAM capabilities that protect customers and support growth.

You will help build and maintain backend services that power registration, login, authorization, and account lifecycle flows across B2C and B2B experiences. You will work with experienced engineers and partner teams to deliver scoped identity features with strong security fundamentals, reliability, and operational rigor.

What you’ll do

- Build and ship customer-facing authentication features—from smoother login experiences to MFA, step-up authentication, and device binding—with mentorship from experienced engineers.

- Develop backend services and APIs in Python or Kotlin, turning product requirements into working software that helps customers access their accounts securely.

- Work with modern identity technologies such as Okta, Auth0, and ForgeRock, writing custom code and integrations that connect identity capabilities to web, mobile, and partner applications.

- Take scoped features through the software development lifecycle: contribute to design, write readable code and automated tests, participate in code reviews, and deploy to production with support from the team.

- Solve real engineering problems by debugging services, improving reliability, and using logs and metrics to understand how your code behaves in production.

- Collaborate with engineering and product partners, learn secure development practices, and grow your software engineering skills while building expertise in authentication.

What we look for

We’re looking for a Mid-Level Software Engineer with solid engineering fundamentals, a passion for authentication, and an eagerness to learn customer identity and access management. You do not need extensive authentication or CIAM experience—we value your ability to build software, solve problems, and grow in the space.

- Demonstrated ability to write, test, and debug software in Python, Kotlin, or a similar language through coursework, internships, personal projects, open source, or professional work. No fixed minimum years of experience required.

- Foundational understanding of backend development, including APIs, data structures, databases, and version control.

- Genuine curiosity about how authentication works and motivation to build secure, reliable customer experiences. Prior experience with identity protocols or CIAM platforms is a plus, not a requirement.

- A practical problem-solving approach, willingness to ask questions, and openness to learning through mentorship and code review.

- Clear communication and the ability to collaborate with engineering, product, and security teammates.

- This position requires either equivalent practical experience or a Bachelor’s degree in a related field.

Base Pay Grade - L
Equity Grade - 6

Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills.

Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include equity rewards, monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents.)

USA base pay range (CA, WA, NY, NJ, CT) per year: $165,000 - $225,000
USA base pay range (all other U.S. states) per year: $146,000 - $206,000

#LI-Remote

Remote-first with flexibility built in
Affirm is proud to be a remote-first company. Most roles can be done from almost anywhere within the country of employment. Some positions may occasionally require in-person work at an Affirm office, and a few are office-based due to the nature of the work. All new hires will be invited to attend an in-person onboarding experience.

Benefits designed for you
Our benefits reflect our commitment to care, transparency, and flexibility. Here are a few highlights:

- Health coverage at no cost: We cover 100% of premiums for employees and their dependents.

- Spending stipends: Monthly stipends support your tech setup, and the ability to choose health and wellness options that are right for you.

- Time off to recharge: Flexible time off and generous holiday calendars help you rest when you need to.

- Own a piece of what you build: Our employee stock purchase plan (ESPP) lets you buy Affirm stock at a discount.

We’re committed to providing an inclusive interview process, including accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you need support, we’re happy to help.

For positions based in San Francisco or Los Angeles: Affirm considers qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, as required by law.

By clicking "Submit Application," you acknowledge that you have read Affirm's Global Candidate Privacy Notice and consent to the use of your personal information as described.

jobs.title: Software Engineer II, Cloud Applications
jobs.description:
ROLE SUMMARY

We’re looking for a Software Engineer II to join the Cloud Applications team. This team builds and operates critical parts of the Temporal Cloud customer experience, including Namespaces https://docs.temporal.io/cloud/namespaces, Audit Logs https://docs.temporal.io/cloud/audit-logs, and Export https://docs.temporal.io/cloud/export.

Namespaces are the core unit of isolation within Temporal Cloud, providing security boundaries, workflow management, unique identifiers, and dedicated gRPC endpoints. Audit Logs and Export give customers reliable access to the operational and compliance data they depend on.

We're looking for an engineer who is excited to learn these systems and contribute to their scalability, reliability, and developer experience. This is a hands-on role where you'll collaborate with experienced engineers, product managers and partner teams to design, build, and operate backend services and data pipelines while growing your distributed-systems expertise.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Design, implement, test, and ship well-scoped features and improvements for Temporal Cloud with support from teammates.

 - Build and improve services that support namespace provisioning, configuration, scalability, and reliability.

 - Develop data pipelines that process high-volume usage and operational data across multiple tenants.

 - Make thoughtful engineering tradeoffs with guidance, balancing data freshness, query cost, tenant isolation, reliability, and operational complexity.

 - Improve service operability through tests, instrumentation, dashboards, alerts, runbooks, and documentation.

 - Participate in code reviews, design discussions, incident response, and production debugging.

 - Collaborate across engineering, product, and customer-facing teams to understand requirements and deliver scoped projects safely.

 - Improve developer and customer experience through automation, better tooling, and incremental product improvements.


WHAT YOU'LL BRING

 - Experience building and operating production backend systems in a cloud environment.

 - Proficiency in Go or another applicable backend or systems language, with the ability to ramp up in an existing codebase.

 - Strong computer science fundamentals, including data structures, concurrency basics, testing, and debugging.

 - Working knowledge of distributed-systems concepts such as reliability, fault tolerance, consistency, scaling, and failure handling.

 - Experience with databases, data pipelines, messaging systems, or object storage.

 - The ability to take a scoped problem, break it into smaller tasks, implement a solution end to end, and incorporate feedback.

 - An operational mindset, including familiarity with logging, metrics, tracing, deployment, and production troubleshooting.

 - Comfort collaborating across teams and communicating progress, risks, and technical tradeoffs clearly.

 - A commitment to correctness, maintainability, and leaving systems better than you found them.


NICE TO HAVE

 - 3+ years of work experience

 - Experience with Go.

 - Experience with PostgreSQL, Redshift, Kinesis, Firehose

 - Experience with S3, Google Cloud Storage, Azure Blob Storage, or other object-storage systems.

 - Familiarity with Kubernetes and cloud infrastructure.

 - Experience supporting on-call rotations, investigating incidents, or improving production observability.

 - Familiarity with Temporal concepts—or a strong interest in learning the platform.


TECHNOLOGY STACK

 - Primary language: Go

 - Data storage: PostgreSQL, Redshift, S3,Google Cloud Storage, Azure Blob Storage, ClickHouse

 - Data processing: Kinesis, Firehose

 - Infrastructure: Kubernetes

 - Core framework: Temporal

You do not need experience with every technology in our stack. We value strong engineering fundamentals and the ability to learn unfamiliar systems.

Temporal Technologies is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Temporal Technologies does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need. We embrace and celebrate differences and diversity.

Temporal is committed to providing access, equal opportunity, and reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities in employment, its services, programs, and activities. If you need to request a reasonable accommodation, please let your Recruiter know so we can assist.

jobs.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Before Stripe, every growing internet platform needed a payments team. Today, every growing internet platform needs a way to establish trust in its users.

Identity verification is a core piece of economic infrastructure for online businesses. Stripe Identity enables businesses to digitally verify their users through identity documents and other signals for fraud prevention, regulatory, and trust and safety use cases. We are building the future of identity verification and trust in the digital economy.

The Identity Product Experience team owns Stripe Identity’s mobile SDKs for iOS, Android, and React Native. These SDKs enable businesses to embed secure, high-quality identity-verification experiences directly in their mobile applications. Our work spans mobile user experience, reusable SDK architecture, camera and document-capture experiences, developer experience, security, accessibility, reliability, and integration with Stripe’s backend systems.

Why Stripe Identity?

- Build mobile experiences that help establish trust between businesses and their users.

- Solve challenging product and technical problems involving mobile platforms, sensitive data, fraud prevention, and global scale.

- Create SDKs used by developers across industries, including fintech, marketplaces, and online platforms.

- Help shape the future of digital identity and make verification easier, safer, and more accessible.

Our vision is to build the world’s most trusted store of verified identities, enabling frictionless identity verification across Stripe and beyond.

We’re looking for engineers who care deeply about mobile craft and the entire user journey. You should enjoy translating complex technical and regulatory requirements into simple, polished experiences; working through ambiguity; and learning new technologies and systems.

Join us to build mobile identity-verification experiences that businesses can integrate easily and that their users can trust.

What you’ll do

Responsibilities

As an iOS engineer on the Identity team, you will:

- Design, build, and maintain Stripe Identity’s mobile SDKs and verification experiences across iOS, Android, and React Native.

- Create intuitive, polished experiences for complex flows such as identity-document and selfie capture, while accounting for accessibility, device capabilities, and varied real-world conditions.

- Build reliable and extensible SDK APIs and reusable components that make it easy for developers to integrate Stripe Identity into their applications.

- Work across mobile clients, supporting APIs, and services to deliver features end to end rather than treating the mobile application as an isolated layer.

- Improve SDK performance, reliability, observability, testing, release processes, and backward compatibility.

- Make thoughtful architectural decisions that balance user experience, developer experience, security, privacy, and long-term maintainability.

- Partner closely with product managers, designers, machine-learning engineers, backend engineers, user researchers, and other mobile teams.

- Work with Stripe users and field teams to understand integration challenges and turn their feedback into product and platform improvements.

- Help establish and evolve mobile-engineering practices across Identity and Stripe.

- Operate and maintain the systems and SDKs the team owns, including diagnosing production issues and improving them based on what we learn.

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

- 3+ years of professional software-development experience, including meaningful experience building and shipping mobile applications or SDKs.

- Experience developing for at least one major mobile platform using technologies such as Swift or Objective-C for iOS

- Strong software-design fundamentals and experience creating maintainable APIs, components, or frameworks.

- Experience delivering mobile functionality beyond an isolated UI layer for example, integrating with APIs and services, handling local state, or working with device capabilities.

- Experience testing, debugging, monitoring, and improving mobile software in production.

- Ability to collaborate effectively with engineering, product, design, and other technical and non-technical partners.

- A demonstrated commitment to building high-quality user and developer experiences.

Preferred qualifications

-

- Experience building mobile SDKs, shared libraries, or developer-facing APIs used outside your immediate team.

- Experience with both iOS and Android, or with cross-platform technologies such as React Native or Kotlin Multiplatform.

- Experience with camera, image-processing, document-capture, biometrics, or other device-integrated mobile experiences.

- Experience designing mobile software that handles sensitive data and applies security and privacy principles by default.

- Familiarity with accessibility, internationalization, mobile performance, and unreliable network conditions.

- Experience with mobile CI, automated testing, release automation, observability, or developer-productivity tooling.

- Experience contributing to backend APIs or services that support mobile products.

- Ability to simplify complex requirements and favor durable, scalable solutions.

- Comfort reasoning clearly and moving with urgency in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment.

- Familiarity with Stripe’s products, ideally through integrating Stripe APIs or SDKs into another application.

jobs.description:
Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase, we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” Learn more about working at Coinbase.

Coinbase Corporate Security (CorpSec) is seeking a Security Engineer to build and maintain security controls that protect corporate infrastructure, user devices, enterprise applications, and network communications. You'll partner closely with IT and engineering teams to identify risks and ship tailored solutions that keep users secure without introducing unnecessary friction, directly protecting Coinbase's most sensitive data and critical assets.

What you'll do:

- Design, implement, and maintain security solutions to harden Coinbase's macOS, Chromebook, and mobile endpoints, focusing on secure configurations, compliance, threat detection, and user experience.

- Perform security reviews on enterprise systems and software that enable user productivity across the corporate environment.

- Collaborate with cross-functional partners to integrate endpoint and SaaS security into broader corporate engineering initiatives.

- Identify and close data exfiltration paths introduced by local AI agents and developer tooling (e.g., coding assistants, LLM harnesses) running on corporate endpoints.

- Provide technical guidance and code review support to engineers on the CorpSec team, raising the security bar across the organization.

Required Skills and Experience:

- 3+ years of experience in security engineering, with at least 2 years securing macOS or similar user endpoints in an enterprise environment.

- Proven ability to write production code (services, integrations, automations) that supports corporate infrastructure security.

- Experience scoping, prioritizing, and shipping security projects end-to-end with minimal direction in fast-moving environments.

- Familiarity with device trust, zero trust network access, or endpoint communication security products (e.g., Cloudflare, Prisma Access, Zscaler).

- Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality.

jobs.description:
About Us

Twitch is the world’s biggest live streaming service, with global communities built around gaming, entertainment, music, sports, cooking, and more. It is where thousands of communities come together for whatever, every day.

We’re about community, inside and out. You’ll find coworkers who are eager to team up, collaborate, and smash (or elegantly solve) problems together. We’re on a quest to empower live communities, so if this sounds good to you, see what we’re up to on LinkedIn and X, and discover the projects we’re solving on our Blog. Be sure to explore our Interviewing Guide to learn how to ace our interview process.

About the Role

The Community Growth organization is driving measurable audience growth, engagement, and revenue for our streamers while delivering exceptional experiences that delight our viewers. Our mission is to make Twitch a place viewers return to daily because their relationship with their favorite creator feels continuous, meaningful, and easy to re-enter when life gets busy.Our teams build consumer-facing features that let viewers engage with their favorite Creators, spanning both web and mobile surfaces. Which part of that experience we focus on changes often, but some of the spaces we own include Channel Points, Polls, Predictions, Watch Streaks, Raids, and the Creator Dashboard. This role is full stack, with responsibilities that include developing for both web and mobile clients, creating backend services, and maintaining those systems.

You Will

- Work with product managers, designers, technical leads, and other engineers to design, develop, launch, and operate interactive experiences and products

- Work backwards from customer problems to drive business impactMaintain and improve our existing backend services

- Maintain and improve our existing backend services

You Have:

- Experience developing software in a professional environment

- Prior experience building consumer-facing products at scale

- Proficient coding skills in modern languages and frameworks such as Go, React, Kotlin, Swift, Objective-C etc

- Proven ability with thinking though and delivering quality user experiences.

- Minimum of Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience

Bonus Points

- Experience with languages/frameworks we use at Twitch: React, Typescript, Golang

- Experience building software and services using AWS technologies such as ECS, DynamoDB, Lambda, SQS, and Step Functions

- Familiarity with Twitch, gaming, and/or streaming on Twitch

- Medical, Dental, Vision & Disability Insurance

- 401(k)
